name: Zeltplatz Falkencamp
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Zeltplatz Falkencamp is located in Schwangau on the edge of the nature reserve. The pitches are generously laid out and surrounded by trees. Guests benefit from the proximity to the Royal Palaces Neuschwanstein and Hohenschwangau, as well as the mountain landscape of the Allgäu. The campsite offers modern sanitary facilities and a small grocery store. The peaceful atmosphere is suitable for nature lovers and families who want to actively explore the surroundings.
